title: Bit Unpacking
text: Deconstruct data frames, {Input port (packed) data types} sets Packed data type; {Bit Patterns} selects bit pattern, {Input port (packed) dimension} sets the packed data dimension, {Output port (unpacked) data types (cell array)} sets the unpacked data type, {Output port (unpacked) dimension (cell array)} sets the unpacked data dimension and {Sign extend} enables sign extension. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input port (packed) data types
params.values: Packed data type uint32 (default) | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | boolean
